histogram.name: Ttc.GetPointer.CaptureLatency
Ttc.GetPointer.ImageBytes
histogram.summary: The size of the encoded image, of the page around where the user pointed, that a call of the get_pointer tool in a TTC session answered with. Recorded for each call that is answered with an image.

histogram.name: Ttc.GetPointer.LocationCount
histogram.summary: How many places the user pointed at were reported by a call of the get_pointer tool in a TTC session. Recorded for each call that is answered with an image. It is 0 when the image is of the text the user had selected rather than of where they pointed.

histogram.name: Ttc.GetPointer.Outcome
histogram.summary: How a call of the get_pointer tool in a TTC session ended: with an image of what the user pointed at, with the answer that they were not pointing, or with an error. Recorded once for each call that is answered; a call still in progress when its session ends is not counted.

histogram.name: Ttc.GetPointer.TotalLatency
histogram.summary: How long a call of the get_pointer tool in a TTC session took, from the call to the answer. Recorded for each call that is answered with an image.
